title: HotbarCustomizer
description: This mod allows you to fully customize your hotbar to match your personal style and gameplay needs. transparency, and overall design for a cleaner and more modern HUD experience.
body:
# 🎮 Custom Hotbar Mod ✨

**Make your Minecraft hotbar truly YOURS!**  
With this mod, you can fully customize your hotbar with different styles, colors 🌈🔥

## ✨ Features
- 🎨 Change hotbar colors
- 💎 Clean modern UI
- 🖱️ Easy in-game settings menu
- ⌨️ Open the settings menu anytime with **'O'**

## 📌 Why use this mod?
Because the default Minecraft hotbar is boring 😴  
Create your own unique style and improve your gameplay experience! 🔥

## ⚙️ Compatibility
- ✅ Fabric
- ✅ Minecraft 1.21.11
- ✅ Multiplayer friendly

# 💬 Feedback
Have ideas or found bugs?  
Feel free to share suggestions and help improve the mod! ❤️
